cc:Work.dc:title: ISO 10628-2:2012 Groups 1-2
cc:Work.dc:description: P&ID legend ISO 10628-2:2012(en) symbol groups 1-2 (vessels and tanks; columns with internals). Drawing area and reference dimensions specified by ISO 5457:1999(en). Title block specified by ISO 7200:2004(en). Font is ISO 3098-compliant "osifont" ( https://tracker.debian.org/pkg/fonts-osifont ).
